theme_and_archetype.description: Grounded, natural, matte. Warm, inviting, and mindful, moving away from glossy tech aesthetics into an editorial publication feel.

typesetting_rules: H1 must use text-4xl to text-6xl clamp, tracking-tight.
Overlines must be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em] (e.g., for 'APRIL TASKS').
Line height for body must be loose (leading-relaxed).

rules: No pure #000000 or pure #FFFFFF. Use #F7F5F0 for white, #1C231A for black.
Background gradients should be avoided. Use flat matte colors or subtle noise textures.

spacing_and_layout.containers: Containers with borders must use internal padding p-6 or p-8.

grids.marketing_sections: Mode A: 'Tetris' Grid (gap-8 to gap-12, col-span mixing).
grids.dashboard_my_garden: Mode B: 'Control Room' Grid (gap-6, high density but flat design).

surface_strategies.cards: Solid flat backgrounds matching the parent or surface_background, 1px delicate inner stroke (border-border_color), NO drop shadow or very soft diffuse shadow.
surface_strategies.headers: Solid background #F7F5F0 with a hard bottom border. Avoid glassmorphism to keep the raw earthy feel.
surface_strategies.buttons: Flat terracotta (#C65D47) or dark green (#2D4A22) with crisp edges. Hover states must be a lighter hue.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.

hero_backgrounds.description: Someone waters plants in pots on a balcony - Mindful growing hero image.
Two potted plants on a weathered windowsill - Sub-section 'Your First Pot'.

plant_database_and_cards.description: Hanging plants in colorful pots - 'Space-Saving Ideas' section.
Close up of a green leaf with drops of water - Background texture for 'Pest & Disease Control'.

texture_details.description: Macro leaf - Use as section break texture or background for the seasonal calendar.

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: Codebase uses .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write React components using JSX in .js files.

Do not use generic SaaS cards. The 'My Garden' dashboard and 'Plant Database' should have an editorial feel. Use pure HTML/Tailwind with flex/grid instead of standard Shadcn Cards where possible. Apply the 1px subtle inner border instead.
Data testing: Include `data-testid` on ALL interactive elements, especially in the Region Picker, Tasks, and 'Add to My Garden' buttons.
Icons: Use `lucide-react`. Avoid emojis entirely. Keep icon stroke-width thin (e.g., 1.5) to match the elegant serif typography.
Storage: Since there is no auth, implement 'My Garden' persistence using `localStorage`. Create a custom hook for managing user plants and current region state.

Mock AI Service: Implement a mock service (or API endpoint) simulating Claude Sonnet 4.5 that returns region-specific planting schedules, pest info, and tasks based on the selected region and current month. Highlight this flow as MOCKED.
Feature setup: Implement an auto-detect geo-location mockup that defaults to a generic region if denied, allowing manual override via a dropdown.
Aesthetic check: Make sure headers use the serif font (Cormorant Garamond) and are dark green (#2D4A22), with terracotta (#C65D47) for key CTAs (e.g., 'Add to Garden', 'Mark Task Complete').
